reviews.text: Kaleb does phenomenal work. Honest, timely, and follows through on everything he committed to. He went above and beyond to make sure I had a great experience. I couldn’t be happier with his work and will absolutely be using his services in the future.

​I can't recommend Kaleb enough. He's done two jobs for me, a large project and a smaller one &  has delivered exceptional results every time. Kaleb is not only a skilled plumber but also incredibly honest and a great communicator. If you need a trustworthy professional, he's your guy.

BEST Plumbing Company out there. Kaleb came to my house today to fix a leak I had in my bathtub. He did absolutely everything he could to get it fixed without breaking the bank. They are very fair with their pricing and you can trust them 100%. I could not recommend them enough! 10/10
Kaleb and his digging crew were great!!!! They had my whole house redone in less than a week from digging tunnels to taken out cast-iron pipe and putting new pvc in. I highly recommend this company
If you need a plumber you have to call these guys! We had the utmost professional and clean service when our water heater started leaking. Got a new one in quickly and at an unbeatable price.

Kaleb is great. He knows his stuff, is reasonably priced, and honest. He made sure we had all the info we needed, explained things clearly, and really helped us out with our house we are selling. I plan to call him and refer him for any future plumbing issues we or our friends may have. Plus, it’s always a bonus to support a small business.

Awesome company.  Kaleb explained anything that we would need.  His crews are very respectful and left zero mess after digging 60ft of digging in two locations under the house.  If you're looking for a reputable and honest company, these are your guys.  Thanks for everything Kaleb.

My water meter outside of my home was leaking. Running water in the street.  Of course the city and my warranty company said... "That's on you!!!" 😂 After several quotes; I found a company that took care of the situation in record time with awesome work. If you ever have any plumbing issue please consider using Pipe and Peak Plumbing!  Very affordable and does AWESOME work.

Quality work was done recently by Pike and Peak Plumbing in replacing two hot water heaters in our home!  Kaleb, Bobby and Andrew were very polite, informative and thorough in doing this job.  They did not waste any time and explained the process to us throughout the installation. Kaleb also gave us great information on how to maintain our water heaters.  A huge plus was his pricing and cost for replacing these water heaters!  His company is a Blessing to us and we will definitely be contacting

We had a slab leak in a home we just moved into.  Kaleb correctly diagnosed the problem and quickly scheduled the repair. Quality work and very professionally done. Kaleb clearly explained what needed to be done. Appreciated the transparency - no surprises.

Had a very positive experience with Pipe & Peak. Caleb was easy to contact and communicated throughout the repair process. We had a slab leak under the driveway. He gave us a couple of options for making the repair then started quickly and completed the repair. Would definitely recommend.

I've had the pleasure of utilizing Pipe and Peak’s services countless times; from my own personal homes, investment properties, family properties and neighbors. I cannot recommend them enough. You will not be disappointed, from a small job to total makeover, give them a call!
Kaleb and his team were awesome. Friendly, professional, and honest. Could not recommend Pipe and Peak more highly.

Kaleb came out and installed a brand new hot water tank as well as a toilet in my spare bathroom. He made the process seamless and his turnaround time was amazing from initial inquiry to install. I would highly recommend him for all your plumbing needs- thank you Kaleb and team!!

Pipe and Peak is the absolute best plumbing service in Arlington and surrounding areas. Kaleb is extremely professional. He is transparent and competitive with his pricing, the most punctual plumber I’ve ever dealt with, and very friendly as well. He is very skillful, a master at his craft. I will not use any other plumbing service. I HIGHLY recommend Pipe and Peak for all your plumbing needs.

After reading the wonderful reviews given by customers, we went ahead and called and Caleb responded quickly.  He gave us a quote with great pricing and installed a new toilet in our rental home the next day.  He is very easy to work with, great in communication, efficient in his work and delivery, and very knowledgeable. We highly recommend him for your plumbing needs and services.  We are so thankful that we found him.  Thank you, Caleb!

Kaleb is a very kind man! I had an issue with my plumbing on a weekend and happened to see his truck on my street. I walked over to see if he could help me out. He was kind and approachable, and got me on the schedule instantly.

He came out to look at the problem and was upfront about his pricing.  There were no crazy weekend rates, and was very reasonable with his costs. Due to the weird layout of my home’s pipes, he had to refer me to a friend of his with more specialized equipment. However,
Once again, Kaleb is the best plumber I've ever turned to.  He was prompt, fair on price and dogged in his pursuit of our complete satisfaction,   I recommend him completely.

So grateful for the team at Pipe and Peak Plumbing.  They have taken care of any plumbing need I've had from an emergency during the big freeze of 2020 to other more every day plumbing needs.  I truly wouldn't use anyone else.  They are honest, communicative, professional, considerate, flexible and reasonable.  I hope you'll give them a try next time you need a great plumber.

Caleb and his team replaced all the old cast iron plumbing under my 47 year old home and replaced 2 toilets and all my washing machine connections. This took several days because my house sits on almost solid rock and it was done by tunneling under my house.
We were not disturbed inside the house except for the noise of the jackhammering and we didn't have to replace any flooring which was a big savings.

Kaleb is great! If you have any plumbing issues or questions then he's the one for the job. He's very professional and I'm so glad I called him to help me out.

Our home is more than 50 years old and has some deteriorating plumbing. We had a leaking pipe between the walls which was difficult to locate.
